en.summary: This commit fixes the TCU DSP fused-dot-product datapath by correcting an off-by-one multiplier-result hookup and explicitly driving the reduction adders in add mode.
why_it_counts: The patch changes arithmetic datapath wiring inside a DUT tensor-compute backend.
The main DSP hunk directly affects which partial products enter the reduction tree and how the adders operate.
The functional payload is local enough to reinject as a precise datapath fault.
disqualifiers: The same commit also contains simulation-trace guard cleanup and declaration cleanup that are not the primary injection target.
evidence: In hw/rtl/tcu/VX_tcu_fedp_dsp.sv, multiplier output m_axis_result_tdata changes from nult_result[i+1] to nult_result[i].
The DSP reduction adders and final accumulator gain s_axis_operation_tvalid=1 and s_axis_operation_tdata=8'b0, explicitly selecting add mode.
The VX_tcu_fedp_dpi.sv and VX_tcu_fedp_int.sv changes only normalize the red_in array declaration shape to LEVELS+1.
VX_platform.vh and VX_tcu_pkg.sv changes are simulation and tracing guards, not tensor datapath behavior.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A fused dot-product or reduction datapath relies on two invariants: each multiplier lane must feed the matching leaf of the accumulation tree, and any configurable adder primitive in that tree must be forced into add mode. If one product is connected to the wrong reduction slot, or the add or subtract mode is left implicit, the accumulated tensor result can silently drop, duplicate, or mis-sign partial sums.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The DUT computes a multi-lane dot product or matrix MAC using pipelined multiplier outputs that feed a reduction tree or final accumulator.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Shift the multiplier-result connection by one position when feeding the reduction tree, and if the target uses configurable adders, stop explicitly forcing those adders into add mode.
portability_notes: The lane-misindex portion is the most portable part of this bug and is sufficient on a generic RTL reduction tree.
The add-op-control portion only applies when the target uses vendor or library adders with an explicit add or subtract select input.
Keep the rest of the reduction structure intact so the error is isolated to product placement or adder mode.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the vector of multiplier outputs that becomes the leaf inputs of a dot-product or reduction tree.
Reconnect one or all of those leaves to the next lane index instead of the matching lane index, preserving widths and timing.
If the adder primitive has an operation-select port, remove the constant add drive or leave it at its buggy default.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DSP FEDP multiplier-output capture and reduction-adder control
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix reconnects each DSP multiplier result from nult_result[i+1] to nult_result[i] and explicitly drives every reduction fadd and the final accumulator with operation=add.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_tcu_fedp_dsp.sv, change the multiplier output back to nult_result[i+1], and remove the constant add-mode control pins on the reduction adders and final fadd.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Tensor fused-dot-product results become numerically incorrect because one or more partial products are misplaced in the reduction tree, or a reduction stage performs the wrong arithmetic mode.
evidence_for_injection: The only clearly behavioral TCU datapath edits are in VX_tcu_fedp_dsp.sv.
The off-by-one product hookup directly changes which multiplier output drives each reduction leaf.
The added operation pins prove the adder mode was important enough to force explicitly.
notes: For a minimal and portable reinjection, restoring the off-by-one lane hookup is enough.
The declaration cleanups in VX_tcu_fedp_dpi.sv and VX_tcu_fedp_int.sv are not required for the fault.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 TCU DSP fused-dot-product 数据通路：它纠正了乘法结果接线中的 off-by-one 错误，并显式把规约加法器驱动到加法模式。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了 DUT 张量计算后端中的算术数据通路连线。
DSP 主 hunk 直接影响哪些部分乘积进入规约树，以及加法器以什么模式工作。
功能性内容足够局部，适合重新注入为精确的数据通路故障。
disqualifiers: 同一提交还包含仿真跟踪保护和声明清理，这些不是主要注入目标。
evidence: 在 hw/rtl/tcu/VX_tcu_fedp_dsp.sv 中，乘法器输出 m_axis_result_tdata 从 nult_result[i+1] 改为 nult_result[i]。
DSP 规约加法器和最终累加器新增了 s_axis_operation_tvalid=1 与 s_axis_operation_tdata=8'b0，显式选择加法模式。
VX_tcu_fedp_dpi.sv 和 VX_tcu_fedp_int.sv 的改动仅仅是把 red_in 数组声明统一成 LEVELS+1 的写法。
VX_platform.vh 与 VX_tcu_pkg.sv 的改动属于仿真和跟踪保护，而非张量数据通路行为。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: fused dot-product 或规约数据通路依赖两个不变式：每个乘法 lane 必须把结果送入规约树中匹配的叶子节点；规约树里的可配置加法器原语必须被明确设为加法模式。如果某个乘积接到了错误的规约槽位，或者加/减模式没有被显式固定，最终张量结果就可能静默丢失、重复或带上错误符号。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 部分乘积到规约树的映射
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: DUT 使用流水化乘法输出驱动规约树或最终累加器，以实现多 lane 点积或矩阵 MAC。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把乘法结果送入规约树时整体错位一个索引；如果目标使用可配置加法器，则不再显式强制这些加法器工作在加法模式。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 规约输入 lane 索引错连
portability_notes: 其中最可移植的部分是 lane 错位接线；对于普通 RTL 规约树，仅这一点就足够。
加法模式控制这一部分只适用于带显式加/减选择输入的 vendor 或库加法器。
保持规约结构其他部分不变，使错误集中在乘积放置或加法模式上。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位乘法输出向量，以及它们作为叶子输入进入点积或规约树的位置。
把其中一个或全部叶子改接到下一个 lane 索引，而不是匹配索引，同时保持位宽和时序不变。
如果加法器原语存在操作选择端口，就删除常量加法驱动，或让它回到有问题的默认状态。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DSP FEDP 的乘法结果捕获与规约加法控制
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把每个 DSP 乘法结果从 nult_result[i+1] 改回 nult_result[i]，并把每级规约 fadd 及最终累加器的 operation 显式驱动为 add。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_tcu_fedp_dsp.sv 中，把乘法结果重新接回 nult_result[i+1]，并去掉规约加法器及最终 fadd 上固定为加法模式的控制引脚。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 张量 fused-dot-product 结果会出现数值错误，因为一个或多个部分乘积被送到了错误的规约位置，或者某个规约级使用了错误的算术模式。
evidence_for_injection: TCU 数据通路里唯一明确的行为性修改集中在 VX_tcu_fedp_dsp.sv。
乘法结果的 off-by-one 接线会直接改变每个规约叶子接收哪个乘法输出。
新增 operation 引脚说明加法器模式必须被显式驱动。
notes: 若只想做最小且可移植的重注入，只恢复 off-by-one 的 lane 接线即可。
VX_tcu_fedp_dpi.sv 与 VX_tcu_fedp_int.sv 中的声明清理不需要纳入该故障。
